body.name: constant-gap Gaussian witness
body.construction: Let \(P^\dagger\) have \(X_t\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\operatorname{Unif}(\mathcal X)\) and conditionally independent Gaussian arm outcomes with variance \(\sigma^2\). If \(\int_{\mathcal X}\{1-\pi_0(x)\}\,dx\ge1/2\), set the arm-zero and arm-one means to \(-\Delta_\dagger/2\) and \(\Delta_\dagger/2\), respectively; otherwise interchange those two means.
